english.title: Driving licence - fail to notify disability
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a driving licence and during the period for which the licence remained in force, failed without reasonable excuse to notify forthwith the Secretary of State in writing of the nature and extent of a disability upon becoming aware that

(A)_[you were suffering from a relevant or prospective disability which you had not previously disclosed to the Secretary of State]_
(B)_[a relevant or prospective disability from which you had suffered and previously disclosed to the Secretary of State had become more acute since the licence was granted]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 94(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was the holder of a driving licence, became aware that

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was suffering from a disability, namely **(..SPECIFY DISABILITY..), of which the Secretary of State had

(C)_[not been notified.]_
(D)_[been notified which had become more acute since the licence had been granted.]_

The defendant failed to notify the Secretary of State in writing of the nature and extent of the disability.
